context.text: The beat began as eight bars Low Deep made at 17 for a producer challenge on the RWD Forum.
The vinyl came out on Colourful State Records, the label he had just signed to, and sold over 2,000 copies.
Low Deep is from Luton; his beats were later used on BBC Top Gear and in the 2007 film Mr. Lonely.
Low Deep's 'Jedi' appears in Son Raw's 2014 'Classic Grime Riddims' mix.
